title: Freezer Fan Motor Error
shortDescription: The freezer evaporator fan motor has failed or is obstructed.
fullDescription:
Samsung freezer shows 21E when the control board cannot detect proper rotation of the evaporator fan inside the freezer compartment. This fan circulates cold air from the evaporator coils throughout the freezer.

When the fan fails, the freezer may warm up even though the compressor still runs. Ice buildup on the evaporator cover, a seized motor bearing, or a disconnected wire harness are the most common causes.

causes.cause: Ice buildup jamming the fan blade
Loose or damaged wiring harness to the fan

symptoms: Ice on back wall of freezer

fixSteps.title: Unplug the freezer
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect power for safety before opening the evaporator cover.

fixSteps.title: Remove evaporator cover
fixSteps.instruction: Empty the freezer, remove shelves, and unscrew the rear interior panel.

fixSteps.title: Thaw ice buildup
fixSteps.instruction: Manually defrost any ice covering the fan blade or evaporator. Use a hair dryer on low or leave door open overnight.

fixSteps.title: Test and replace fan
fixSteps.instruction: Spin the fan by hand. If it does not spin freely or does not start after power-on, replace the motor.

whenToCallPro: Call a technician if the fan spins freely and wiring is intact, since this points to a control board fault requiring diagnostics.
videoSearchQuery: Samsung freezer 21E error fix evaporator fan

faq.q: Can I still use the freezer with 21E?
faq.a: Briefly, but food will thaw. Address the error within hours.
Only temporarily if ice was the issue and defrosted on its own.

title: Evaporator Sensor Error
shortDescription: The evaporator temperature sensor is shorted or open circuit.
fullDescription:
Error 22E indicates the evaporator thermistor is reporting values outside the expected range. This sensor tells the control board when to run defrost cycles.

Without a valid reading, defrost timing becomes unreliable and frost accumulation accelerates, eventually blocking airflow.

fixSteps.title: Access the evaporator
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug, empty freezer, remove rear panel inside freezer compartment.

fixSteps.title: Check sensor connector
fixSteps.instruction: Locate the thermistor clipped to the evaporator and verify the plug is fully seated.

fixSteps.title: Measure resistance
fixSteps.instruction: At room temperature the thermistor should read approximately 5 kOhm. Replace if open or shorted.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if the sensor tests good but 22E persists after reset, since the main PCB may need replacement.

faq.a: Not immediately, but prolonged operation causes frost buildup and food loss.

title: Defrost Heater / Sensor Error
shortDescription: The defrost heater circuit or defrost sensor has failed.
fullDescription:
Code 24E means the control board attempted a defrost cycle but the evaporator temperature did not rise as expected. This typically indicates a burned-out defrost heater, an open bi-metal thermostat, or a failed defrost thermistor.

Ignoring this error leads to thick frost on the evaporator and eventual loss of cooling.

fixSteps.title: Unplug and access evaporator
fixSteps.instruction: Remove rear freezer panel after unplugging the unit.

fixSteps.title: Continuity test heater
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect heater leads and measure resistance. Open circuit means replace.

fixSteps.title: Replace defrost components
fixSteps.instruction: Install a new heater and thermal fuse kit. Route wiring identically to original.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if you are not comfortable working with heater element wiring near sealed refrigerant lines.

faq.q: Can I skip defrost and keep using it?
faq.a: No. Frost will eventually block airflow and stop cooling entirely.

title: Freezer Temperature Sensor Error
shortDescription: The main freezer compartment temperature sensor is faulty.
fullDescription:
Error 39E is triggered when the freezer compartment thermistor reports an implausible reading. The board cannot regulate the compartment without valid data and defaults to a safe mode.

The sensor is a small two-wire thermistor clipped near the top or back of the interior cabinet.
symptoms: Compartment too warm or too cold

fixSteps.title: Locate the sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Remove the interior light cover or top panel to find the thermistor.

fixSteps.title: Test and replace
fixSteps.instruction: Measure resistance. Swap in a new thermistor if outside spec.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if replacement does not clear the code, since wiring continuity to the PCB may need testing.

faq.q: Can I unplug and restart to clear 39E?
faq.a: Yes temporarily, but the code will return if the sensor is faulty.

title: Defrost Sensor Short Circuit
shortDescription: The defrost sensor circuit is shorted.
fullDescription:
5E indicates a short on the defrost thermistor circuit. The board reads an impossibly low resistance and halts the defrost cycle to prevent damage.

Water intrusion into the sensor connector is a common culprit after multiple defrost cycles.

causes.cause: Water / ice bridging the sensor pins

fixSteps.title: Unplug and thaw
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug freezer and allow full defrost so the connector dries out.

fixSteps.title: Inspect connector
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect thermistor, dry pins with isopropyl alcohol, reseat firmly.

fixSteps.title: Replace if needed
fixSteps.instruction: If the error returns within 24 hours, install a new defrost thermistor.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if the sensor and wiring test good yet 5E persists.
videoSearchQuery: Samsung freezer 5E defrost sensor short fix

faq.a: Yes, some older displays show S where newer panels show 5.

title: Defrost Sensor Open Circuit
shortDescription: The defrost thermistor is reading open circuit.
fullDescription:
6E is logged when the defrost thermistor wiring is open. Without the sensor the defrost cycle will not terminate correctly, so the board disables it and notifies the user.

A broken wire at the connector strain relief is the most frequent root cause.

fixSteps.title: Reseat the connector
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug freezer, remove evaporator cover, firmly reseat thermistor plug.

fixSteps.title: Continuity test
fixSteps.instruction: Measure wire continuity from thermistor to board connector. Repair or replace broken leads.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if wire repair is outside your comfort zone or connector is inaccessible.
videoSearchQuery: Samsung freezer 6E defrost sensor open circuit

faq.q: Will the freezer still cool with 6E?
faq.a: Initially yes, but frost will eventually block airflow.

title: Ambient Sensor Error
shortDescription: The outside ambient temperature sensor has failed.
fullDescription:
Code 13E is shown when the external ambient thermistor is not providing valid data. Samsung uses this sensor to adapt compressor and defrost behavior to kitchen temperature.

The freezer will continue cooling using default parameters, but efficiency may drop.

fixSteps.title: Pull the freezer out
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect power and carefully move the unit away from the wall.

fixSteps.title: Access rear cover
fixSteps.instruction: Remove the upper rear service panel to locate the ambient sensor.

fixSteps.title: Replace thermistor
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug the old sensor, install the new one in the same clip, and secure the harness.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if the cabinet is built in and cannot be pulled out easily.

faq.a: Not immediately, but energy consumption will rise until repaired.

title: Defrost Fuse Error
shortDescription: The one-shot thermal fuse in the defrost circuit has opened.
fullDescription:
14E signals that the defrost thermal fuse has tripped, usually because the defrost heater overheated after repeated failed cycles. The fuse is a safety device that must be replaced, not reset.

After replacement verify the root cause, otherwise the new fuse will trip again.

causes.cause: Stuck defrost heater or shorted sensor

fixSteps.title: Full defrost
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug and leave the freezer open for 6-12 hours to melt all ice.

fixSteps.title: Replace fuse and retest
fixSteps.instruction: Install new thermal fuse, reassemble evaporator cover, and power up.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if the new fuse opens again within a few days, since the heater or sensor is likely faulty.

faq.a: No. Bypassing creates a fire risk.

title: Communication Error PCB to Display
shortDescription: Main PCB and display board have lost communication.
fullDescription:
Error 41E is reported when the display panel cannot talk to the main control board. The freezer may continue to run, but most settings are locked.

The cause is usually a loose ribbon cable or damaged display harness, though power surges can also damage the display board itself.

fixSteps.title: Hard reset
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug for 5 minutes then restore power.

fixSteps.title: Reseat display cable
fixSteps.instruction: Pop off the display bezel, disconnect and reconnect the ribbon cable.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if reseating does not help, since diagnosing which board to replace requires experience.

faq.a: Usually yes, though controls are limited until the error clears.

title: Inverter Compressor Error
shortDescription: The inverter compressor driver has reported a fault.
fullDescription:
Code 83E is logged when the inverter PCB driving the compressor reports an over-current or lock-rotor fault. The compressor will be stopped and retried periodically.

Causes include a failed inverter board, a seized compressor, or low incoming voltage.

fixSteps.title: Check mains voltage
fixSteps.instruction: Verify the outlet supplies 110-125V (or 220-240V on EU units) with a multimeter.

fixSteps.title: Unplug for 10 minutes
fixSteps.instruction: Power down, wait 10 minutes, restore power to see if fault clears.

fixSteps.title: Call technician
fixSteps.instruction: If 83E returns, a sealed-system technician should inspect the inverter and compressor.

whenToCallPro: Always call a pro if swapping the inverter does not clear 83E, since compressor replacement involves refrigerant handling.

faq.a: Not necessarily. The inverter board fails more often than the compressor.

title: Condenser Fan Error
shortDescription: The condenser fan at the rear of the freezer has stalled.
fullDescription:
Error 27E means the condenser fan tachometer signal is missing. This fan blows air across the hot condenser coils at the back of the freezer.

Without it the compressor overheats and the freezer cannot maintain setpoint, so the board stops cooling to protect the sealed system.

fixSteps.title: Clean the fan
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug, remove rear bottom access panel, and vacuum the fan and condenser coils.

fixSteps.title: Replace motor
fixSteps.instruction: If the fan still does not spin freely, install a new motor assembly.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if the new motor still does not spin, since the PCB fan driver may be damaged.

faq.q: How often should I clean the condenser?
faq.a: Every 6-12 months, especially if you have pets.

title: Freezer High Temperature Alarm
shortDescription: The freezer compartment has warmed above its safety threshold.
fullDescription:
FE on Samsung freezers is a high-temperature alarm rather than a component fault code. It appears after a long door opening, a power outage, or when another fault has prevented cooling.

The alarm clears automatically once the compartment returns to the set temperature.

fixSteps.title: Close and wait
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure the door is sealed. Press mute and wait up to 4 hours for the alarm to clear.

fixSteps.title: Check other codes
fixSteps.instruction: If FE does not clear, look for companion codes like 21E or 83E and address them first.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro only if FE persists with no other fault visible after 24 hours.
videoSearchQuery: Samsung freezer FE high temperature alarm

faq.a: If the freezer was above 4C for more than 2 hours, discard perishable items.

title: Door Open Alarm
shortDescription: The freezer door has been open longer than two minutes.
fullDescription:
OC is a door alarm, not a hardware failure. It usually means the door did not close fully or the door switch has failed.

If the alarm triggers with the door closed, the reed switch on the cabinet frame is likely stuck.

fixSteps.title: Check gasket
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect the door seal, wipe clean, and close door firmly.

fixSteps.title: Test door switch
fixSteps.instruction: Activate the switch manually. If interior light does not respond, replace the switch.

whenToCallPro: Rarely needed. Call a pro only if switch wiring is damaged behind the cabinet.
videoSearchQuery: Samsung freezer OC door open alarm

faq.q: How do I silence OC temporarily?
faq.a: Press any control button to mute for 60 minutes.

title: Power Failure Indicator
shortDescription: The freezer detected a recent power interruption.
fullDescription:
PC (Power Cut) is an informational flag that the freezer lost power at some point. Samsung displays this so you can inspect food safety after returning from a trip.

Press any button to dismiss. No repair is required unless PC reappears repeatedly, which can indicate a loose mains plug or bad outlet.

fixSteps.title: Dismiss the alert
fixSteps.instruction: Press any button on the control panel to clear PC.

fixSteps.title: Check outlet
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure the plug is fully seated and the outlet is not on a flaky GFCI circuit.

whenToCallPro: Call an electrician only if PC appears despite a known-good outlet.
videoSearchQuery: Samsung freezer PC power failure indicator

faq.a: Only if freezer held below -6C throughout. When in doubt, discard.

title: Display Self-Test / Demo Mode
shortDescription: The freezer is in showroom demo mode or performing a self-test.
fullDescription:
When 88 88 appears with no cooling, the unit is in demo mode. In this mode controls light up but the compressor will not run.

Exit by holding Energy Saver and Freezer buttons for 8 seconds (model dependent) until a chime sounds and the display shows the setpoint.

fixSteps.title: Exit demo mode
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Energy Saver + Freezer for 8 seconds until a tone plays.

fixSteps.title: Verify cooling
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm the compressor starts within a few minutes after exiting demo mode.

whenToCallPro: Not required unless the unit will not exit demo mode.

faq.q: Why did my new freezer come in demo mode?
faq.a: Retailers use it to keep display units quiet. Exit on first use.
